race.comment: GOLDSTAR SALLY (5) turned spotting a big start finishing fourth (20.27) last time in a Grade 5 at this track. Should be very hard to beat this time. SPRING GRIM (1) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing fifth (19.88) last time in a Grade 5 at Q Straight. Solid record here winning eight races. Boasts a strong record from this draw with five wins and three minor placings from 12 starts. Likely to be about the money. MR. LASSO (3) has been beaten for early speed lately, last time finishing sixth (19.92) in a Grade 4/5 at Capalaba. Has a good record here including 11 wins. The form out of the last run is proven to be strong. Leading chance. MAGIC SHAZAM (6) is a last-start placegetter at this track and distance - in the mix again.
